text: Take a few akshatalu and a little water in your right hand.
Recite the sankalpam according to today's tithi and nakshatram.
Make the sankalpam: on this Deepavali, I am doing the puja of Sri Mahalakshmi Ammavaru for the well-being of my family, for long life and good health, for happiness, and for wealth and prosperity.
When the sankalpam is done, leave the akshatalu and the water in the plate.
